questions.question: The source says gifted children most often lose their abilities as adults, and cites 50%, 70% and 90% intellectual-development figures without identifying the psychological research. Should these claims be documented or qualified? All source claims and figures are retained.
The source says Wiener joined or was invited to MIT’s mathematics department at 19. Should this be checked against the commonly recorded 1919 appointment? The source age is retained.

Figure 12 calls the 17-pointed star an ornament on Gauss’s grave, while the body says he requested a 17-gon there. Should the pictured monument’s location and the fulfilment of that request be clarified? Both source descriptions are retained.

The source credits Gauss with completely resolving regular-polygon constructibility. Should the attribution distinguish his construction criterion from the later proof of necessity? The original attribution is retained.
